reason: Finite windows count a compulsory first sample, so fixed60 realizes 1440.032 checks per day. A literal <=1440 cap would reject its own reference. Also selecting S2_720 at the 1440 resource point would mislabel the literature baseline.
deterministic_and_empirical_rule: For each nominal budget 720/1440/2880, use the paired empirical checks of fixed120/fixed60/fixed30 as the cap. Minimize F, then O, then M60, calls and numeric parameters.
S2_rule: Keep the LP policy with that nominal budget. Report its actual checks on replay and flag overshoot. Do not claim a hard empirical budget guarantee.
audit: The initial literal nominal-cap selections remain in tuning-results.json under resource_selection_initial_literal_nominal_cap.
status: Clarification after validation outcomes, before final test; not retrospectively described as preregistered.
